notes: Free API; their terms ask for a link back to the Remotive URL (kept as the job url). Default category software-dev; a profile can set `url` (?category=marketing, sales, customer-support...).
First array element is a legal notice; terms ask for attribution and a followed link back.
RSS: front-end and full-stack categories by default; a profile can set `urls` to other category feeds.
Defaults to Europe and development; a profile can set `url` with other geo/industry values (geo=latam, industry=marketing).
Exposed jobs feed; `categories` is a pattern over category names (default development).
Latin America, often in Spanish, many non-tech categories. Off unless a profile enables it with `categories`.
